description: Fetch the full source code, npm dependencies and file list for one free ReactFrame component by slug, in shadcn/ui registry format. Only works for free components — premium ones return their catalog metadata plus a link to preview them on reactframe.com instead of source.

slug.description: The component's slug, e.g. "toggle-pro" or "pie-chart". Use search_components to find slugs.

name: get_component
title: Get a ReactFrame component's full source
